id: \rSapphire: My name is Sapphire. I've conquered all the Hoenn gyms with resounding strength and in a quick amount of time.
en: \rSapphire: My name is Sapphire. I've conquered all the Hoenn gyms with resounding strength and in a quick amount of time.
it: \rSapphire: Mi chiamo Sapphire. Ho conquistato tutte le Palestre di Hoenn con una forza schiacciante e in pochissimo tempo.

id: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Conqueror.
en: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Conqueror.
it: \rPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Conquistatrice.

id: \rSapphire: Don't look at me. I need to get better before you take me seriously.
en: \rSapphire: Don't look at me. I need to get better before you take me seriously.
it: \rSapphire: Non guardarmi. Devo migliorare prima che tu mi prenda sul serio.
